verdict.rationale: Slack's own pricing and AI pages say every message, file, and conversation is saved and fully searchable, so full-history search is documented. Nothing in the pack shows filters by sender, channel, or date, or any admin-specific search scope. missing for 10: documented search filters (sender/from, channel/in, date ranges), admin-scoped search across all conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can search the full message history with filters like sender, channel, and date

citations.quote: Every message, file, and conversation shared in Slack is saved and fully searchable.
if it's shared in or integrated into Slack, it's searchable.
